name: letmepost
label: Letmepost
description: Publish and schedule posts to Bluesky, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, Facebook, Pinterest, and TikTok through one API

base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description: The API base URL. Use `https://api.letmepost.dev` for the hosted service, or your own origin when self-hosting. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.description: Your letmepost API key (`lmp_live_…` or `lmp_test_…`). Create one in the dashboard under API keys.

reply_to_post.label: Reply to a Post
reply_to_post.description: Publish a reply under an existing post on X, Threads or Bluesky

account.label: Account
account.description: The X, Threads or Bluesky account that replies. You can also map an account id from List Accounts.

media.label: Media
media.description: Media attachments. Give each item a public URL or an existing letmepost media ID, not both.

replyToTweetId.label: X tweet ID
replyToTweetId.description: X accounts: id of the tweet to reply to.

replyToThreadsId.label: Threads post ID
replyToThreadsId.description: Threads accounts: id of the Threads post to reply to.

replyToUri.label: Bluesky parent URI
replyToUri.description: Bluesky accounts: at:// URI of the post to reply to (results uri of a publish).

replyToCid.label: Bluesky parent CID
replyToCid.description: Bluesky accounts: CID of the post to reply to (results cid of a publish).

replyRootUri.label: Bluesky root URI
replyRootUri.description: Bluesky accounts, optional: at:// URI of the first post of the thread, when replying to a reply.

replyRootCid.label: Bluesky root CID
replyRootCid.description: Bluesky accounts, optional: CID of the first post of the thread. Give it together with the root URI.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency key
idempotencyKey.description: Reusing the same key never publishes twice, which makes retries safe (up to 128 characters, remembered for 24 hours).

cancel_post.label: Cancel a Scheduled Post
cancel_post.description: Cancel a queued scheduled post before it publishes

postId.label: Post ID
postId.description: The letmepost post id of the queued post (from the Post IDs of a publish, or List Posts).

accountId.label: Account
accountId.description: The connected account. You can also map an account id from List Accounts.

list_pinterest_boards.label: List Pinterest Boards
list_pinterest_boards.description: List the boards of a connected Pinterest account

accountId.label: Pinterest account
accountId.description: The connected Pinterest account. You can also map an account id from List Accounts.
